name: Light Fixture
instruction: Create a simple light fixture with a round base that can be mounted on the ceiling. It should have a single bulb socket in the center.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a light fixture.
The base of the fixture is round.
The bulb socket is centrally located.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The size of the bulb socket is proportionate to the round base.
The overall height of the fixture is balanced with the base diameter.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The round base is correctly oriented for ceiling mounting.
The bulb socket is positioned directly above the center of the base.
Object distance and contact: The bulb socket does not extend beyond the edges of the base.
There is no gap between the bulb socket and the base.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are accurately represented.
The design follows the instruction for a simple light fixture.
